data.body: Disposable publication rehearsal finding: the first fixed-post identity run was invalid because rewrite-clone still exposed both old  and rewritten  refs; the verifier's global position map selected old-epoch anchors, making all 1,129 reported nonverified events appear grandfathered. The same clone's synthetic writer branch  had merged old tip , so old-tip ancestry was true—an intentional safety failure, not an acceptable rehearsal result. Rebuilt a clean disposable bare remote with only rewritten tip , then default-cloned it: refs contain only rewritten ; old tip is not even present; commit count 65,769; merge count 4,469; size-pack 152,488 KiB (<150 MiB). A fixed-verifier identity scan is running against this publication-faithful clone before any synthetic write.
